content.text:
Perfect! All 256 tests pass. The late fee feature is complete.

**What was implemented:**
- Added `lateFee(invoice, asOf)` to src/reports.js
- Calculates late fee at 0.04% per day of the amount still due
- Returns 0 if:
  - Invoice is draft
  - Invoice is not yet overdue (dueDate ≥ asOf)
  - No amount is due (fully paid or overpaid)
- Formula: late fee = (due × daysOverdue × 0.0004), rounded to nearest cent
- daysOverdue = daysBetween(dueDate, asOf) when dueDate < asOf

**Test coverage includes:**
- No fee when not overdue
- No fee when due on asOf date
- Fee calculation for overdue invoices
- Correct rate (0.04% per day)
- Fee accumulation with days overdue
- No fee for draft invoices
- No fee for paid invoices
- Fee accounting for partial payments
- No fee for fully paid invoices
- Proper rounding to integer cents
- Works with different payment terms (NET14, EOM, NET30)
- Works with complex invoices (discounts, VAT)
- Always returns integer cents
- Fee increases with longer delays

All 256 tests pass (241 previous + 15 new).
